import os, re
from collections import defaultdict

internal = "/bench/repo/internal"
repo = "/bench/repo"

# Collect declarations: (name, recv_type, path, exported)
decl_re = re.compile(r'^func\s+(?:\(([^)]+)\)\s+)?([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*\(')

decls = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(internal):
    for f in files:
        if not f.endswith('.go') or f.endswith('_test.go'):
            continue
        path = os.path.join(root, f)
        rel = os.path.relpath(path, repo)
        with open(path) as fh:
            for i, line in enumerate(fh, 1):
                m = decl_re.match(line)
                if m:
                    recv, name = m.group(1), m.group(2)
                    decls.append((name, recv, rel, i))

print(f"Total declarations: {len(decls)}")
# unique names
from collections import Counter
names = Counter(d[0] for d in decls)
print(f"Unique names: {len(names)}")
print("Most common names (possible collisions):")
for n,c in names.most_common(20):
    print(f"  {n}: {c}")
print("\nAll decls:")
for name, recv, rel, i in decls:
    print(f"{name}\t{recv or '-'}\t{rel}:{i}")
PY
